relations.text: BARKが10-Kで、販売先のネット市場にChewyを挙げる
relations.text_en: BARK sells through online marketplaces including Chewy

source.label: BARK 10-K(2026年3月期)
source.quote: We sell our products in two segments: Direct-to-Consumer ("DTC") and Commerce, through our network of retail partners, which currently spans over 50,000 doors nationwide and online marketplaces including Amazon, Chewy and TikTok.

relations.text: Better Choiceが10-Kで、ネット販売先にChewyを挙げる
relations.text_en: Better Choice sells to online retailers such as Chewy

source.label: Better Choice 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: E-commerce, which includes the sale of product to online retailers such as Amazon and Chewy;

relations.text: Zomedicaが10-Kで、販売チャネルにChewyを挙げる
relations.text_en: Zomedica sells through retail channels such as Chewy

source.label: Zomedica 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: we sell through retail channels such as Amazon and Chewy.

relations.text: 犬の下痢治療薬Canalevia-CA1をChewyで販売
relations.text_en: Its dog diarrhea drug Canalevia-CA1 is available through Chewy

source.label: Jaguar Health 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Canalevia-CA1 is now available to multiple leading veterinary distributors in the US, including Chewy.

relations.text: Dognessが20-Fで、ネット販売先にChewyを挙げる
relations.text_en: Dogness expands sales on online platforms such as Chewy

source.label: Dogness 20-F(2024年6月期)
source.quote: Furthermore, we continue to expand our sales on online shopping platforms, such as Amazon and Chewy, to reach more potential customers.

source.quote: Users may purchase our terminals on online e-commerce platforms such as Amazon, Chewy, TikTok, JD and T-mall.
